card.name: Last digit of numbers and years
card.fires_on: The final digit (or ending like -three, th) of a multi-digit number, mostly a year such as 1997 or 2005, or a count such as 1,817. It fires as the number is completed.

modes.label: Last digit of a year
modes.description: The final digit of a four-digit year before a noun like study, interview or medal.

modes.label: Number endings
modes.description: A number ending such as -three or th that completes a number.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a following noun for a counted item and away from Chinese measure words, so it signals that a number has just ended.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a year or a count, right where the number finishes.
